act_title: The Government of Union Territories Act, 1963
title: Restriction on discussion in the Legislative Assembly.―No discussion shall take place in the
text:
36. Restriction on discussion in the Legislative Assembly.―No discussion shall take place in the

Legislative Assembly of [the Union territory] with respect to the conduct of any Judicial Commissioner
or of any judge of the Supreme Court or of a High Court in the discharge of his duties.
